p.e1.en: icanspeak English works without an account; in fact there are no accounts at the moment. Your learning progress never leaves your browser: your streak, practised tasks, learned words, settings and started exams are stored only in your device's *localStorage*. We cannot see them, and they are gone as soon as you delete your browser data.

p.e2.en: We set no cookies and use no advertising or error-monitoring services. Data leaves your device in three cases: when you open the site (the host's server log data), for cookieless traffic measurement that stores nothing on your device (see “Traffic measurement with PostHog”), and when you choose “Correct my text” in a writing task yourself (see “Text correction with LanguageTool”).

p.tdddg.en: This storage is strictly necessary so that the exercises you use can remember where you are (§ 25 Abs. 2 Nr. 2 TDDDG). It needs no consent and no cookie banner.

p.analytics1.en: To understand which pages and exercises are used and where technical errors occur, we use **PostHog** (PostHog Inc., USA), with data processed on servers in the EU (Frankfurt), in cookieless mode: PostHog sets no cookie and stores nothing in your browser. So that several visits on the same day count as one, PostHog computes a hash on its server from your IP address and browser identifier with a key that changes daily. The IP address itself is not stored. This means we cannot recognise you across days.

p.analytics2.en: We build no user profiles, record no sessions and send nothing you type in exercises. Because nothing is stored on or read from your device, no consent under § 25 TDDDG is needed. You can object to the measurement at any time (Art. 21 GDPR) by a simple e-mail. A tracking blocker in your browser also prevents it. More in [PostHog's privacy policy](https://posthog.com/privacy).

r6.data.en: Usage data: page visited, referring page, browser, operating system, screen size, approximate location (country, city), clicks on page elements, loading times and technical error messages

r6.where.en: At PostHog (servers in the EU), without a cookie and without storing anything on your device

p.lt.en: In writing tasks you can have your text checked with “Correct my text”. Only then does your browser send the text from the input field and its language to the public service **LanguageTool** (LanguageTooler GmbH, Germany). For technical reasons, LanguageTool also receives your IP address. We do not receive or store the text ourselves. So please do not put personal details in a text you have checked. How LanguageTool processes the data is explained in [LanguageTool's privacy policy](https://languagetool.org/legal/privacy).

p.voice.en: To read words and sentences aloud, the site uses the speech output of your browser or operating system. Some browsers use online voices from their maker for this; the maker then processes the text that is read aloud under its own terms. We receive nothing from this.

p.mic.en: The site uses the microphone only when you start a recording yourself; your browser asks for permission the first time. Your recordings (“Record”, “My recording”) stay on your device and are gone as soon as you leave the page. There is currently no automatic pronunciation scoring through an online service.

Produkthaftungsgesetz (Ürün Sorumluluğu Kanunu) kapsamındaki talepler saklıdır.
p.liab1.uk: Ми несемо необмежену відповідальність за умисел і грубу необережність, а також у разі шкоди життю, тілу чи здоров'ю. У разі простої необережності ми відповідаємо лише за порушення суттєвого договірного обов'язку — тобто обов'язку, виконання якого взагалі уможливлює належне користування і на дотримання якого ти можеш покладатися, — і в розмірі, обмеженому типовою для договору передбачуваною шкодою. Вимоги за Produkthaftungsgesetz (Законом про відповідальність за продукцію) залишаються незмінними.
p.liab1.vi: Chúng tôi chịu trách nhiệm không giới hạn đối với hành vi cố ý và sơ suất nghiêm trọng cũng như đối với tổn hại đến tính mạng, thân thể hoặc sức khỏe. Trong trường hợp sơ suất thông thường, chúng tôi chỉ chịu trách nhiệm khi vi phạm một nghĩa vụ hợp đồng cơ bản — tức là một nghĩa vụ mà việc thực hiện nó mới giúp việc sử dụng đúng cách trở nên khả thi và việc tuân thủ nó là điều bạn có thể tin cậy — và giới hạn về số tiền ở mức thiệt hại có thể lường trước, điển hình cho hợp đồng. Các yêu cầu theo Produkthaftungsgesetz (Luật Trách nhiệm Sản phẩm) không bị ảnh hưởng.
p.liab1.hi: जानबूझकर किए गए कार्य और घोर लापरवाही के लिए, तथा जीवन, शरीर या स्वास्थ्य को हानि के लिए हम असीमित रूप से उत्तरदायी हैं। साधारण लापरवाही की स्थिति में हम केवल किसी आवश्यक संविदात्मक दायित्व के उल्लंघन के लिए उत्तरदायी हैं — यानी ऐसा दायित्व जिसके पूरा होने से ही उचित उपयोग संभव होता है और जिसके पालन पर आप भरोसा कर सकते हैं — और राशि में अनुबंध के लिए सामान्य, पहले से अनुमान लगाए जा सकने वाले नुकसान तक सीमित हैं। Produkthaftungsgesetz (उत्पाद दायित्व अधिनियम) के तहत दावे इससे अप्रभावित रहते हैं।
p.liab1.id: Kami bertanggung jawab tanpa batas atas kesengajaan dan kelalaian berat serta atas cedera terhadap nyawa, tubuh, atau kesehatan. Dalam hal kelalaian ringan, kami hanya bertanggung jawab atas pelanggaran kewajiban kontraktual yang esensial — yaitu kewajiban yang pemenuhannya baru memungkinkan penggunaan yang semestinya dan yang kepatuhannya dapat Anda andalkan — dan jumlahnya terbatas pada kerugian yang dapat diperkirakan dan lazim untuk kontrak tersebut. Klaim berdasarkan Produkthaftungsgesetz (Undang-Undang Tanggung Jawab Produk) tetap tidak terpengaruh.
p.liab1.es: Respondemos de forma ilimitada en caso de dolo y negligencia grave, así como por daños a la vida, al cuerpo o a la salud. En caso de negligencia leve, respondemos solo por el incumplimiento de una obligación contractual esencial (es decir, una obligación cuyo cumplimiento hace posible en primer lugar el uso correcto y en cuyo cumplimiento puedes confiar), y de forma limitada en su cuantía al daño previsible y típico del contrato. Las reclamaciones según la Produkthaftungsgesetz (Ley de responsabilidad por productos) no se ven afectadas.
p.liab1.pt: Respondemos de forma ilimitada por dolo e culpa grave, bem como por danos à vida, ao corpo ou à saúde. Em caso de negligência leve, respondemos apenas pela violação de uma obrigação contratual essencial — ou seja, uma obrigação cujo cumprimento torna possível, antes de tudo, o uso adequado e em cujo cumprimento você pode confiar — e limitados em valor ao dano previsível típico do contrato. As pretensões com base no Produkthaftungsgesetz (Lei de responsabilidade pelo produto) permanecem inalteradas.
p.liab1.tl: Mananagot kami nang walang limitasyon sa sinadyang pagkakamali at malubhang kapabayaan, at sa pinsala sa buhay, katawan o kalusugan. Sa kaso ng simpleng kapabayaan, mananagot kami lamang sa paglabag sa isang mahalagang obligasyon sa kontrata — ibig sabihin, isang obligasyong ang pagtupad ay nagbibigay-daan sa wastong paggamit sa unang lugar at kung saan maaari kang umasa sa pagsunod — at limitado ang halaga sa inaasahang pinsalang tipikal para sa kontrata. Hindi apektado ang mga paghahabol alinsunod sa Produkthaftungsgesetz (Batas sa Pananagutan sa Produkto).
